bundle.shortDescription: A fast, secure, offline Markdown reader
bundle.longDescription: Markdown Viewer is a calm, fast desktop reader for Markdown files. It renders GitHub-flavored Markdown with syntax highlighting, an outline, full-text search, folder browsing and live reload, entirely offline.
